audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Envy, prosperity of harmful people, doubt, sanctuary insight, body, and nearness to God.

verses.restored: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

familiar.text: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

modern.text: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

original.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֭וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב

verses.restored: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

familiar.text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

modern.text: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט נטוי רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן שפכה אֲשֻׁרָֽי

verses.restored: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

familiar.text: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

notes.title: Prosperity of the wicked
notes.body: The psalm openly observes that harmful people can prosper. Material success is therefore not reliable evidence of divine favor or moral worth.

modern.text: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

original.text: כִּֽי קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

familiar.text: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

modern.text: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.

original.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם

verses.restored: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

familiar.text: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

modern.text: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.

original.text: בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ

verses.restored: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

familiar.text: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

modern.text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.

original.text: לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

familiar.text: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

modern.text: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.

original.text: יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב

verses.restored: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

familiar.text: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

modern.text: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

original.text: יָמִ֤יקוּ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ

verses.restored: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

familiar.text: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

modern.text: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.

original.text: שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

familiar.text: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

modern.text: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.

original.text: לָכֵ֤ן ישיב עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

familiar.text: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

modern.text: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”

original.text: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן

verses.restored: Behold, these are the wicked, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

familiar.text: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

modern.text: Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.

original.text: הִנֵּה אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ חָֽיִל

verses.restored: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

familiar.text: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

modern.text: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.

original.text: אַךְ רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽי

verses.restored: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

familiar.text: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

modern.text: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.

original.text: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים

verses.restored: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

familiar.text: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

modern.text: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.

original.text: אִם אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֭וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי

verses.restored: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

familiar.text: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

modern.text: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight

original.text: וָֽ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל היא בְעֵינָֽי

verses.restored: Until I entered the sanctuaries of God; then I understood their end.

familiar.text: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

modern.text: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.

original.text: עַד אָ֭בוֹא אֶל מִקְדְּשֵׁי אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם

verses.restored: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

familiar.text: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

modern.text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.

original.text: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת

verses.restored: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

familiar.text: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

modern.text: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!

original.text: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן בַּלָּהֽוֹת

verses.restored: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

familiar.text: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

modern.text: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.

original.text: כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה

verses.restored: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my innermost being.

familiar.text: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

modern.text: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,

original.text: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן

verses.restored: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

familiar.text: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

modern.text: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.

original.text: וַאֲנִי בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ

verses.restored: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

familiar.text: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

modern.text: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד יְמִינִֽי

verses.restored: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

familiar.text: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

modern.text: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.

original.text: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

familiar.text: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

modern.text: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.

original.text: מִי לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

familiar.text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

modern.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

original.text: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

familiar.text: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

modern.text: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.

original.text: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.

familiar.text: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.

modern.text: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י בַּאדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Prosperity is explicitly shown as morally unreliable; suffering is not proof of failure and wealth is not proof of blessing.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
